claude_proposed_widenings.name: last_charge_branch_lifecycle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing destruction policy only models no destruction, deterministic empty destruction, or a single destroy-on-roll branch. Staff of Power instead has a last-charge trigger with two distinct non-destruction outcomes: partial property loss on 1 and charge recovery on 20.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: remaining_charge_pool_amount
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike scales from the number of charges currently in the staff when it is broken, not from a fixed amount or charges explicitly spent by an existing charge-cast mode. The activation surface needs a way to consume the remaining pool and expose that remainder to downstream damage atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_excludes_source
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The explosion applies to each other creature in the area while the wielder resolves through a separate self branch. Current area attachments do not express "others in area, excluding the source/wielder."
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
